description: Link an order you funded on-chain to its service on Mercadopleis, so the seller sees it with the right listing. Requires login with the buyer wallet. The API verifies the funding transaction on-chain.

serviceId.description: Service slug or UUID used in create_order

sessionToken.description: The sessionToken returned by login. Treat it as a secret: never share it or put it in messages.

name: register_order
